hypothesis: Within-root terminal-margin targets over post-action semantic pair features improve disjoint calibration root Top-1 over static order and state-value v2.
single_variable: Learning target changed from state winner classification to within-root action preference; representation and protocol otherwise frozen.
notes: No Top-1 or regret gain. The production action has the same sole semantic delta (inventoryTotal +3) but terminal-margin effects of +76 in development and -10 in calibration, proving the linear absolute post-state representation cannot express the needed context-dependent sign. An earlier all-deterministic collection was discarded after exceeding the 700-command bound; no partial labels were retained.

hypothesis: Expanding predeclared disjoint roots while holding the model fixed will determine whether iteration 1's action-delta conflict is stable.
single_variable: Development and calibration seed count increased from one to four per split; representation, candidate cap, continuation policy, learner and metrics remained fixed.
notes: All 12+12 roots and 64 candidates completed under one ruleset. Every exact calibration action-delta pattern has both positive and negative terminal labels; all tested models preserve static choices. The next experiment must measure label stability across a small continuation-policy population before adding action-context interactions.

hypothesis: A fixed production root has a stable terminal-optimal action under a small paired official-built-in continuation seed population.
single_variable: Continuation sampling increased from one baseline seed stream to three paired seed streams on four frozen production roots; roots, candidates, acting policy, engine and command bound stayed fixed.
notes: Sample zero reproduced all iteration-2 terminal margins. Every root's preferred candidate flipped under another continuation. The three-sample mean retained the baseline sign on these selected roots but is not a convergence claim. Single-continuation terminal regret is unsuitable as a supervised label; next use paired sequential sampling with uncertainty and abstention.

hypothesis: A predeclared paired sequential decision rule will abstain instead of forcing labels from the noisy three-sample production puncture.
single_variable: Replaced naive sample-mean sign with exact paired terminal-rank sign tests at stages 3/7/15 using alpha spending and per-stage Bonferroni correction; outcomes were unchanged.
notes: All roots correctly request seven samples. Terminal rank is primary; noisy cash means are diagnostic only. This establishes fail-closed semantics before additional simulation spend.

hypothesis: Seven paired continuations will select only production roots with stable terminal-rank evidence and defer all others.
single_variable: Available paired samples increased from three to seven by computing only indices 3-6; roots, candidates, policy, estimator and alpha spending remained fixed.
notes: The resume path preserved all prior values and atomically appended four samples per candidate. No root clears alpha 0.02. One mean cash advantage reversed from -215.67 to +10, reinforcing that cash diagnostics cannot force a label.

hypothesis: At the frozen fifteen-sample maximum, only production roots with stable paired terminal-rank evidence receive labels and every other root becomes an explicit abstention.
single_variable: Available paired samples increased from seven to fifteen by computing only indices 7-14; roots, candidates, policy, estimator and alpha spending remained fixed.
notes: All roots exhausted the predeclared maximum without terminal-rank significance. Rank ties occur in 4-10 of 15 pairs per root. These production roots are excluded from supervised labels under continuation population v1; the maximum will not be enlarged post hoc.
